description: Ministry of Home Affairs - Order declare that 07.05.2018 shall be a Public & Bank Holiday to Celebrate International Labour Day
categorisation: This gazette content is a legal order issued under the Holiday Act, No. 29 of 1971, modifying public and bank holidays. It involves the exercise of statutory powers to create a regulatory change, which fits the definition of Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) concerning regulatory frameworks and legal notices.
